content: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Women University Peshawar (SBBWU) is the first women university of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It aims to empower female students through education, research, and development in scientific, socio-cultural, economic, and political fields.
The Convocation tradition at SBBWU was initiated under the leadership of the founding Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Syeda Farhana Jahangir, establishing it as an annual academic event.
The first convocation was held on 28 March 2012 at the University of Peshawar Convocation Hall, where 213 graduates were awarded degrees.
A total of 154 MS degrees were awarded in Psychology, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, and Statistics, while 59 MA degrees were awarded in Arabic, Islamiyat, and English.
A total of 34 students received Gold Medals for their outstanding academic performance.
The convocation was graced by Chancellor Barrister Syed Masood Kausar (Governor Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) as chief guest, along with distinguished guests, students, and parents.
The Chancellor appreciated the performance of students and congratulated faculty, graduates, and parents. The founding Vice Chancellor delivered the welcome address.
